Transport Documents

Booking Confirmation

An official notice from the carrier, NVOCC, or freight forwarder confirming acceptance of a cargo space reservation for a specific shipment on a given voyage.

Quick answer: An official notice from the carrier, NVOCC, or freight forwarder confirming acceptance of a cargo space reservation for a specific shipment on a given voyage.

Quick answer

Why it matters

Booking Confirmation matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Booking Confirmation?

In this glossary, Booking Confirmation refers to: An official notice from the carrier, NVOCC, or freight forwarder confirming acceptance of a cargo space reservation for a specific shipment on a given voyage.

How is Booking Confirmation used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "The forwarder sent the booking confirmation to the exporter after securing cargo space on the selected vessel."

Why does Booking Confirmation matter in logistics?

Booking Confirmation matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Booking Confirmation?

Booking Confirmation is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Booking Confirmation belong to?

In this glossary, Booking Confirmation is grouped under Transport Documents. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

An official notice from the carrier, NVOCC, or freight forwarder confirming acceptance of a cargo space reservation for a specific shipment on a given voyage.

Operational example

The forwarder sent the booking confirmation to the exporter after securing cargo space on the selected vessel.
